coordinates: Published landscape.canopy geometry in final member metres, baseSeq 33. Root centres extracted from the bottom ring. Height and width approximate. Covered stems match an authored tree within 10 cm.

civicCanopySurvey.coordinates: NParks longitude and latitude projected through the scene geographic reference to final member metres. Retained where OneMap z19 aerial imagery supports vegetation. Excluded road and building interiors using the registered Fix Singapore GP city mesh.
civicCanopySurvey.heightAndWidth: Height estimated within the census band. Crown width and branching approximate the recorded genus.
